data.name: Afsah
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘afs’, meaning ‘to open’ or ‘to clarify’. In Islamic history, Afsah is the name of a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh), known for her truthfulness and clarity in conveying Islamic teachings.
data.numerology_meaning: In numerology, Afsah is a name of determination, intuition, and inspiration. Those with this name are creative, sensitive, and spiritual individuals.

in_arabic.name: أفسح
in_arabic.long_meaning: أفسح هو اسم عربي مشتق من الفعل afsaḥa الذي يعني النطق بوضوح والبيان الصحيح، وهو اسم يرمز إلى الشخص الذي يتكلم بفصاحة ووضوح، وقد استخدم هذا الاسم في التراث الإسلامي لوصف الصحابة والتابعين الذين كانوا معروفين بنطقهم الصحيح والوضوح في كلامهم

in_urdu.name: افسح
in_urdu.long_meaning: افسح ایک عربی نام ہے جو فعل afsaḥa سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے صاف گوئی اور وضاحت، یہ نام اس شخص کی طرف اشارہ کرتا ہے جو فصیح اور واضح گفتگو کرتا ہے، اس نام کا استعمال اسلامی روایت میں صحابہ اور تابعین کی وضاحت کرنے کے لیے کیا گیا ہے جو اپنی صاف گوئی کے لیے مشہور تھے

in_hindi.name: अफसह
in_hindi.long_meaning: अफसह एक अरबी नाम है जो क्रिया afsaḥa से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है स्पष्ट बोलना और व्याख्या, यह नाम उस व्यक्ति की ओर संकेत करता है जो फुसह और स्पष्ट बोलता है, इस नाम का उपयोग इस्लामी परंपरा में सहाबा और ताबईन का वर्णन करने के लिए किया गया है जो अपनी स्पष्ट बोली के लिए प्रसिद्ध थे

in_pashto.name: افسح
in_pashto.long_meaning: افسح د عربی نوم دی چې د افسحا څخه اخیستل شوی دی چې د ښه ویلي او بیان په معنی دی، دا نوم هغه کس ته اشاره کوي چې ښه او بیان کوي، دا نوم د اسلامی روایت په توګه د صحابه او تابعین د ښه ویلي او بیان کولو لپاره کارول شوی دی

data.cultural_impact: Afsah is a beautiful and meaningful name with Arabic origins, often used in Islamic communities due to its historical and cultural significance. The name Afsah carries an important legacy as it was the name of a well-known companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh), known for her clarity in conveying Islamic teachings to others. This name has been passed down through generations, a reminder of the importance of truthfulness and clarity in teaching and living out Islamic values.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Afsah holds deep spiritual significance for Muslims. The root word ‘afs’ meaning ‘to open’ or ‘to clarify’ speaks to the essence of Islamic spirituality. By nature, Allah (God) is the one who opens the hearts and minds to guidance, truth, and understanding. The name Afsah serves as a constant reminder to live a truthful and clear life, clarifying misconceptions, and opening the hearts and minds of others to Islamic teachings. It also inspires a continuous quest for knowledge, seeking clarity and truth in all aspects of life, as well as a call to share knowledge and teachings with others, thus playing a role in the personal and communal spiritual growth of the individual bearing this name.

historical_references.reference: Afsah bint Abi Bakr was a renowned calligrapher and scribe in the Umayyad Caliphate era. She is known to have produced several important works, including the Quran copy held in the Topkapi Palace in Istanbul, Turkey.
historical_references.context: Afsah is considered one of the most important female figures in the history of Islamic calligraphy.

historical_references.reference: Al-Afsah Mosque in Cairo, Egypt, was built during the Fatimid Caliphate in the late 11th century AD. It was named after a famous poet and scholar by the same name, who was a prominent figure in the Fatimid court.
historical_references.context: Al-Afsah Mosque is an important architectural landmark in Cairo, and is named after a significant historical figure in the Fatimid era.
